zachariah-11.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-11.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 2 Chronicles is the only book that names him. The verse is 2 Chronicles 21:2.

zachariah-13.title: Zachariah
zachariah-13.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-13.note: 2 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years. The verse is 2 Chronicles 26:5.

zachariah-14.title: Zachariah
zachariah-14.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-14.note: One of 29 men called Zachariah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 2 Chronicles. The verse is 2 Chronicles 29:13.

zachariah-15.title: Zachariah
zachariah-15.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-15.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 2 Chronicles is the only book that names him. The verse is 2 Chronicles 34:12.

zachariah-16.title: Zachariah
zachariah-16.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-16.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 2 Chronicles names him once.

zachariah-4.title: Zachariah
zachariah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice across 2 Kings and 2 Chronicles.

zachariah-9.title: Zachariah
zachariah-9.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-9.note: 2 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years. The verse is 2 Chronicles 17:7.

zachariah-12.title: Zachariah
zachariah-12.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-12.note: A priest from the divided-kingdom years. 2 Chronicles names him once.

zadok.title: Zadok
zadok.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
zadok.note: The priest who stayed with David through Absalom's rebellion. He would have carried the ark out with the king, and David sent it back. Zadok anointed Solomon, and when Abiathar backed Adonijah and was sent away, Zadok was left as the only high priest.

zadok-3.title: Zadok
zadok-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zadok-3.note: One of 7 men called Zadok. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 2 Kings and 2 Chronicles.

zaham.title: Zaham
zaham.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zaham.note: Rehoboam's son by Abihail, and that is all of him.

zarah-6.title: Zarah
zarah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zarah-6.note: 2 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

zareah.title: Zareah
zareah.note: Samson's hometown, better known as Zorah, on the border of Judah and Dan. The angel of the Lord told Manoah's wife there that she would have a son, and Samson was buried between Zorah and Eshtaol.

zebadiah-6.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zebadiah-6.note: 2 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

zebadiah-7.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zebadiah-7.note: One of 9 men called Zebadiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 2 Chronicles.

zebulun.title: Zebulun
zebulun.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
zebulun.note: Jacob's tenth son and Leah's last. His tribe's land ran up to the Sea of Galilee, and Isaiah names it with Naphtali as the place where a light would dawn, which Matthew applies to Jesus in Galilee.

zedekiah.title: Zedekiah
zedekiah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zedekiah.note: The last king of Judah. Nebuchadnezzar put him on the throne, and he rebelled anyway, against everything Jeremiah told him. Jerusalem was destroyed, he was caught running, his sons were killed in front of him, and then they blinded him.

zedekiah-2.title: Zedekiah
zedekiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zedekiah-2.note: A different Zedekiah from the king. He is the man in 1 Kings 22 and 2 Chronicles 18 who stood with the court prophets, and struck the one prophet who disagreed.

zemaraim.title: Zemaraim
zemaraim.note: Two places. One is a town of Benjamin, generally put at a ruin north of Jericho. The other is a hill in Ephraim where Abijah of Judah beat Jeroboam's much bigger army.

zereda.title: Zereda
zereda.note: Named once, in 2 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

zibiah.title: Zibiah
zibiah.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zibiah.note: She was from Beersheba, and she was the mother of King Joash of Judah, the boy hidden from Athaliah and crowned at seven.

zichri-7.title: Zichri
zichri-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zichri-7.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 2 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

zichri-8.title: Zichri
zichri-8.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zichri-8.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 2 Chronicles names him once.

zichri-9.title: Zichri
zichri-9.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zichri-9.note: A common name. This one is an Ephraimite warrior who killed a son of King Ahaz in the war between Israel and Judah.

zimmah-2.title: Zimmah
zimmah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zimmah-2.note: 2 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

zion.title: Zion
zion.note: The fortified hill on Jerusalem's southeastern ridge that David took from the Jebusites and called the city of David. He built his palace there. Archaeologists have uncovered the Stepped Stone Structure on that ridge, and many tie it to David's time.

ziph.title: Ziph
ziph.note: David hid in the wilderness around Ziph, southeast of Hebron, while Saul was hunting him. The people of Ziph told Saul where he was, twice.

ziz.title: Ziz
ziz.note: The Moabites and Ammonites came up against Jehoshaphat by the ascent of Ziz, a pass near En-gedi on the Dead Sea. It is generally identified with a steep track climbing toward Tekoa.

ziza-2.title: Ziza
ziza-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ziza-2.note: A son of Rehoboam. The other Ziza is a Simeonite prince who took land at Gedor.
